text.zh: 安福路那家小咖啡店，老板擦杯子擦了很久。暖光打在他背上。
text.en: Anfu Rd cafe. The owner wiped glasses for a long time, warm light on his back.

text.zh: 巨鹿路转角，老杂货铺的木门半开着，门口摆着几只旧木箱。
text.en: Corner of Julu Rd. The old grocery's wooden door half open, vintage crates by the door.

text.zh: 永康路弄堂拐角，一只花猫蹲在石阶上看我。
text.en: Alley corner on Yongkang Rd. A calico cat watched me from the stone step.

text.zh: 武康路的法桐落叶了，盖住了车筐。这辆车停在这里很久了。
text.en: Plane tree leaves fell on Wukang Rd, covering the basket. This bike has been here a long time.

text.zh: 愚园路深处，老银杏的金黄铺满了石板路。
text.en: Deep in Yuyuan Rd. The old ginkgo's gold covers the stone path.

text.zh: 一扇旧木门，门牌上的字迹已经看不太清。每次路过都想拍下来。
text.en: An old wooden door, the sign too faded to read. I want to photograph it every time I pass.

text.zh: 路上积了一汪水，倒映出整排秋天的树。
text.en: A puddle on the road reflected a whole row of autumn trees.

text.zh: 黄昏的光从天桥缝隙里漏下来，照在楼梯上。
text.en: Dusk light leaked through the overpass, falling on the stairs.

text.zh: 窗台上摆着旧书和一盆吊兰。每次经过都希望它一直开着。
text.en: Old books and a spider plant on the windowsill. Every time I pass, I hope it stays open.

text.zh: 今天的风把叶子全吹到了人行道上。踩上去沙沙响。
text.en: Today's wind blew all the leaves onto the sidewalk. They crunched underfoot.

text.zh: 昏黄的灯，旧书的味道。我在这里站了十分钟没说话。
text.en: Dim yellow light, the smell of old books. I stood here ten minutes without a word.

text.zh: 弄堂里一辆老自行车靠在墙上，车筐里也积了落叶。
text.en: An old bike leaning against the wall in the alley, leaves piled in its basket.

text.zh: 巷子深处挂着一只红灯笼，天黑之后亮了起来。
text.en: A red lantern hung deep in the alley, lit after dark.

text.zh: 午后，猫在石阶上睡成一摊。我没敢走太近。
text.en: Afternoon, the cat melted asleep on the stone step. I didn't dare get closer.

text.zh: 街角的小店，绿色遮阳篷下摆满了盆栽。老板在里头剪枝。
text.en: Corner shop, green awning covered in potted plants. Owner inside, pruning.

text.zh: 巷子深处的小馆，老板端上来一碗热气腾腾的面。
text.en: Small eatery deep in the alley. Owner brought a steaming bowl of noodles.

text.zh: 老小店的门口总摆着一只篮子，装着今天的几样东西。
text.en: The old shop always has a basket at the door, holding today's few things.

text.zh: 天色暗下来，灯笼从里头透出红光。
text.en: Sky darkened, the lantern glowed red from inside.

text.zh: 前面这位爷爷走得慢，背包带子垂下来一截。我跟着走了两条街。
text.en: The grandpa ahead walked slowly, backpack strap hanging low. I followed for two blocks.

text.zh: 这片红砖楼有拱形窗户，每次路过都觉得它该被拍下来。
text.en: These red-brick buildings with arched windows. Every time I pass, I think they should be photographed.
